comments.text: I just read they are not including recorded wind speeds in the EF scale revamp. They NEED to! If damage indicates only EF3 but recorded wind speed is 312mph then it is an EF5. No need to access damage. I was watching this live. As a former storm chaser I KNOW not to tell people to get in their cars and drive to try and get away from it. MY jaw dropped when I heard Mike Morgan tell people to get in their cars and drive. That is a no no especially on such a mass scale. We are thankful that the tornado didn't last longer or reform over S OKC and the highways or the deaths would have been in the hundreds
